overview_description.description: Pillar is a venture-backed content management platform designed for healthcare, enabling access to health education for increased self efficacy across your population. Whether deployed as a stand-alone hub or embedded in your existing experience, our solution drives utilization of health and wellness resources through a combination of data analytics, automated workflows and SMS messaging.
